title.en: Weathered deck in front of a glazed frame

alt.tr: Cam doğrama önündeki eskimiş deck, dökülen turuncu boya ve çıplak ahşap lekeleri
alt.en: Weathered deck in front of a glazed frame, with flaking orange coating and patches of bare wood

caption.tr: Eski kaplama tahtalardan kalkmış, altından açık renkli ahşap çıkmış. Yenileme öncesi durum.
caption.en: The old coating has lifted off the boards and pale wood shows through. This is the state before renewal.
